title: Prove plugin composition, authorization, and delivery
description: Minimal test plugin with private resource and component using shared types/client; test multiple contributions, invalid config, auth separation, deterministic output and no-plugin parity. Review, lint/type/build/tests, commit/push, draft PR and evidence. Keep open until landing.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Proof plugin specification: As a plugin author, I want two private related models and two newsroom components sharing native Amplify types/client so that multi-resource composition is demonstrably usable. Test-only opt-in; editor/admin only; no public operations. Executable Gherkin will cover opt-in validation, generated authorization contract, notebook/create/list workflow through an injected client, and typed misuse rejection. No cloud deployment or live API verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: CANCELED by Ryan on 2026-10-13: "take back that initiative about creating plugins into Papyrus, cuz I think we just eliminated that entire problem". Prospectus can use existing Kanbus/Virtuus issue storage as a separate application/subdomain with simple configured links/intake; the proposed plugin foundation is therefore no longer needed. All implementation agents stopped immediately. This is cancellation, not completed delivery. Partial work is preserved in the isolated feature/PPY-f8bbd3-plugin-build-foundation worktree and a local archive; no implementation was merged or deployed. No alternative CRM or baseline tables are being implemented. Supersedes this issue and its initiative plan.

right_now_summary: The plugin work was canceled after the team decided the proposed foundation was no longer needed.
